features: This Mobile Accessory Is A Mobile Telephoto Lens Designed For Attachment To A Phone, Giving You A Compact Way To Capture Magnified Shots And Recording
The Clip-Attach Phone Lens Uses A Clip-Attach Style Mounting Design, Making It Easy To Position On A Compatible Mobile Phone For Quick Setup And Stable Use
Built With A Black Cylindrical Body And Red Accent Rings, This Handheld Camera Lens Has A Shielding Eyecup-Style Front Piece For Added Front-End Coverage
As A Telephoto Lens, It Helps Bring Distant Subjects Closer In Photos And Recording, Making It Useful For Detail-Focused Mobile Filming
The Compact Handheld Form Factor Makes This Mobile Telephoto Lens Convenient To Carry And Use Whenever You Want A More Zoomed-On-Mobile Perspective
